# Pump.fun

> Pump.fun is a Solana memecoin launchpad where tokens launch on a bonding curve and can be bought or sold at once, then graduate to a DEX when the curve fills. This page is a non-custodial interface for trading from your own wallet. Memecoins are extremely high risk.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Tokens launch on a bonding curve that sets the price from how much supply has been sold.
- A token graduates when its curve fills, and its liquidity then moves to a DEX pool.
- Fees are paid in SOL: network fee, optional priority fee and any platform or creator fee in the quote.
- The interface is non-custodial: you connect your own Solana wallet and sign every transaction.
- Memecoins are highly volatile and can lose all of their value, so only risk what you can afford to lose.

## Pages
